name: manga-localizer
description: Local-first manga OCR, translation, review, inpainting, and typesetting workbench

scripts.setup: node scripts/external-uv.mjs sync --group dev && node scripts/external-frontend.mjs install
scripts.setup:ai: node scripts/external-uv.mjs sync --group dev --extra ai && npm run setup:models
scripts.setup:mt: node scripts/external-uv.mjs sync --group dev --extra mt && npm run setup:models -- argos-ja-zh
scripts.setup:test: npm run setup && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm run check:launcher && npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:launcher: node --test scripts/dev-platform.test.mjs scripts/app-platform.test.mjs scripts/package-app.test.mjs scripts/storage-data-route.test.mjs scripts/storage-frontend-route.test.mjs scripts/storage-model-route.test.mjs scripts/storage-runtime-route.test.mjs
scripts.check:backend: node scripts/external-uv.mjs run --frozen --offline --no-sync python -m ruff check backend scripts/audit_release.py scripts/bootstrap_clean_plate_run.py scripts/bootstrap_detection_annotations.py scripts/compare_inpaint.py scripts/compare_translate.py scripts/compare_upscale.py scripts/evaluate_detection_ocr.py scripts/evaluate_real_data.py scripts/macos_app_launcher.py scripts/prepare_clean_plate_review.py scripts/review_detection_annotations.py scripts/setup_optional_models.py && node scripts/external-uv.mjs run --frozen --offline --no-sync python -m ruff format --check backend scripts/audit_release.py scripts/bootstrap_clean_plate_run.py scripts/bootstrap_detection_annotations.py scripts/compare_inpaint.py scripts/compare_translate.py scripts/compare_upscale.py scripts/evaluate_detection_ocr.py scripts/evaluate_real_data.py scripts/macos_app_launcher.py scripts/prepare_clean_plate_review.py scripts/review_detection_annotations.py scripts/setup_optional_models.py && node scripts/external-uv.mjs run --frozen --offline --no-sync python -m pytest backend/tests
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.storage:check: node scripts/external-uv.mjs --check && node scripts/external-frontend.mjs --check && node scripts/external-data.mjs --check
